snippet.description:
The 2026 midterms are in the rearview mirror, but the electoral map tells only half the story.

So what are the major moments that stood out after eight months on the road? Vox’s Astead Herndon sits down with America, Actually producer Kasia Broussalian to reflect on their reporting across the country—from town halls in New Jersey to gas stations in Pennsylvania, and canvassing in Nevada. They unpack the underlying tensions that defined the midterms and what those moments reveal about the fast-approaching 2028 presidential cycle.
